nonreactive_branch.meaning: no chemical exchange with traversed host; finite source melting and named receiver crystallisation remain distinct operations
nonreactive_branch.currently_bounded_use: existing liquid on a supported continuous phase branch; no phase birth/death or implicit host mixing
requires: explicit mechanical and thermal boundary conditions
declared pressure and Boussinesq volume-error allowances
timescale support for neglected host reaction and assumed thermal equilibrium

flow.dimension: 2D only with declared along-axis invariance and finite strike width; general ridge and junction route is 3D
flow.density_approximation: positive fixed reference phase transport densities; G25 volumes retained separately and approximation errors assessed
flow.component_balance: paired Gamma_i and actual phase component fluxes; no inventory normalisation to fill geometry
flow.parameters: k_ref,d_ref,phi_ref,n,d,mu_l,eta,zeta_ref,eta_ref,m are declared supported case inputs, not universal defaults
flow.focusing_measure: time-integrated physical receiver mass/component and enthalpy fluxes; incoming and outgoing accounts separate
flow.zero_porosity: dry branch with zero liquid flux; no mass-creating numerical floor

cooling_lid.phase_energy: same-provider phase enthalpy advection; u=h-P*v; fixed-composition dh=T*ds+v*dP
cooling_lid.energy_account: internal plus gravitational storage; material flux, conductive heat, declared heating and exterior mechanical work, with explicit Boussinesq omissions
cooling_lid.diagnostic: boundary of supported connected liquid permeability from evolving thermal/phase state; disconnected or absent barrier retained explicitly
cooling_lid.phase_front: requires compatible provider phase-event support before generated front claim

owners.I01: selected method, assumptions, common-provider semantics and bounded feasibility boundaries
owners.I05: moving component/phase/enthalpy state, pressure/thermal consistency, property feedback and phase-front handling
owners.I06: shared ridge, finite extraction/outlets, receiver accommodation, melt-derived crust birth and ocean history
owners.I02: atomic finite inventories, reservations and replay prevention

choice_and_bounded_feasibility_can_close: corrected-G25 selection bound to retained native and analytical checks
separately owned real compatible segregation controls pass for their restricted branch
focusing and thermal contract with explicit refusals integrated
i01_finish_boundary.later_implementation: I05/I06 moving phase fronts and complete source-to-crust integration
i01_finish_boundary.external_acceptance: independent physical observations and supported route-specific coefficients

minimal_physical_evidence: original G25 calibration provenance and coverage for source, residue, liquid and receiver
independent phase assemblage, composition and melt-fraction observations with P/T/bulk/water/redox uncertainties; check fitting overlap before withheld claim
independent phase energy-difference and volume constraints wherever those accuracy claims are made
supported permeability, grain-size, rheology and thermal-boundary coefficients; independently constrained values preferred to new fitting
reaction/transit and thermal-equilibration timescale support for the restricted nonreactive branch
withheld thermal/geometry response and material-delivery/composition response; crust thickness alone cannot identify both cooling and permeability
predeclared_acceptance_requirements: dry, hydrostatic/zero-gradient, manufactured pressure and finite exhaustion controls
component mass and donor-route-receiver-surroundings energy closure with pressure/gravity/mechanical work
space, time, domain and boundary refinement of delivery, fields and barrier geometry
supported freezing/retention front and no-liquid controls; varied heat/history at fixed spreading rate
same-provider source-to-receiver path, finite cooling account, retained ages and withheld physical comparisons
failure leaves parent uncommitted; no substituted law, inventory or reset state

runnable_case_requirements.null_meaning: must be supplied in an admitted runnable case; never implicit defaults
